title: Building a Second Brain: Overview
description: Building a Second Brain (Tiago Forte) — the PKM system — runs: the CODE (the capture, organize, distill, express — the workflow), the PARA (the projects, areas, resources, archives — the structure), the principles (the borrowed creativity — the building; the capture habit — the ubiquitous), and the payoff (the compounded — the ideas; the reliable — the creativity). The promise: the reliable creativity — the ideas captured, the projects expressed. The principle: the brain extended — the CODE’d, the PARA’d, the expressed.
how_it_works: Capture everything, organize by PARA, distill progressively, express in projects.

title: CODE: Capture
description: Capture (Forte’s C) — the keeping — practices: the what (the resonant — the inspiring; the useful — the actionable; the personal — the experienced), the where (the inbox — the single; the frictionless), and the habit (the daily — the ubiquitous). The 12 problems (the Forte’s — the modern knowledge work’s). The principle: the captured resonant — the kept what moves, the inboxed singly.
key_points: Keep what resonates: inspiring, useful, personal
how_it_works: Notice resonance, capture frictionlessly to one inbox, daily.

title: CODE: Organize (PARA in Depth)
description: PARA (Forte’s) — the depth — sorts: the Projects (the active — the with goals and deadlines; the 5–15), the Areas (the ongoing — the standards; the health, the finance), the Resources (the referenced — the topics; the future), and the Archives (the inactive — the completed; the searchable). The rules: the actionability (the sorted by), the few projects (the focused), and the archive (the freely). The principle: the PARA’d knowledge — the actionability-sorted, the projects-focused, the archived-freely.
how_it_works: Sort captures by actionability, limit active projects, archive completed.

title: CODE: Distill
description: Distill (Forte’s D) — the refining — layers: the highlights (the captured — the marked), the bolding (the key — the emphasized), the summarizing (the brief — the top), and the remixing (the expressed — the original). The progressive summarization (the Forte’s — the layered). The principle: the distilled essence — the highlighted, the bolded, the summarized, the remixed.
how_it_works: Highlight captures, bold key passages, summarize tops, remix into expression.

title: CODE: Express
description: Express (Forte’s E) — the shipping — completes: the intermediate packets (the usable — the distilled notes; the building blocks), the projects (the expressed-through — the real), the showing (the work — the shared), and the compounding (the reused — the multiplied). The principle: the expressed knowledge lives — the packeted, the projected, the shown.
how_it_works: Build packets, express through projects, show publicly, reuse.

title: The Zettelkasten Method
description: The zettelkasten (Luhmann’s) — the slip-box — practices: the atomic (the one-idea — the notes; the Luhmann’s 90,000), the linked (the connected — the IDs; the webbed), the own-words (the understood — the rewritten), the references (the sourced — the literature notes), and the emergent (the conversations — the surprising). The digital (the Obsidian — the Roam; the linked). The principle: the slip-box thinks — the atomic, the linked, the own-worded.
how_it_works: Write atomic own-word notes, link densely, let structure emerge.

title: Evergreen Notes
description: Evergreen notes (the Andy Matuschak’s) — the living — are: the concept-oriented (the ideas — the titled), the densely linked (the webbed), the evolving (the revised — the grown), and the public (the shared — the working notes). The principle: the notes evergreen — the concepted, the linked, the evolved.
how_it_works: Title by concept, link richly, revise continuously, share publicly.

title: The PARA Projects Deep Dive
description: The projects — the PARA’s engine — manage: the defining (the goal — the deadline; the 5–15), the notes (the dedicated — the per-project), the completing (the archived — the celebrated), and the reviewing (the weekly — the active). The principle: the project-driven organization — the defined, the noted, the completed.
how_it_works: Define projects with goals, keep dedicated notes, review weekly, archive done.

title: Areas of Responsibility
description: The areas — the maintained — cover: the standards (the ongoing — the health, the finance, the home), the reviewing (the monthly — the each), and the distinguishing (the projects — the goals; the areas — the standards). The principle: the areas maintained — the standarded, the reviewed monthly.
how_it_works: Define areas with standards, organize notes, review monthly.

title: Resources and Archives
description: The resources/archives — the reference — hold: the resources (the topics — the interested; the future-use), the archives (the inactive — the completed; the searchable), and the maintaining (the pruned — the yearly). The principle: the referenced and archived — the resourced topically, the archived freely.
how_it_works: File resources by topic, archive completed freely, prune yearly.

title: The Capture Habit in Depth
description: The habit — the ubiquitous — builds: the tools (the Readwise, the inbox — the frictionless), the triggers (the resonance — the noticed), the daily (the 5-minute — the processed), and the mindset (the collector — the curator). The principle: the capturing habitual — the frictionless tools, the noticed resonance, the daily processing.
how_it_works: Set up frictionless tools, notice resonance, capture, process 5 min daily.

title: Progressive Summarization in Depth
description: The summarization — the layered — proceeds: the layer 1 (the highlights — the captured), the layer 2 (the bold — the key), the layer 3 (the summary — the top), the layer 4 (the remix — the expressed), and the layer 5 (the narrow — the narrowed further). The use: the future (the skimmed — the layered). The principle: the summarized progressively — the layered for skimming, the remixed for creating.
how_it_works: Highlight, bold key, summarize top, remix, narrow — across passes.

title: Intermediate Packets
description: The packets — the building blocks — are: the distilled (the notes — the usable), the modular (the remixed — the recombined), the project-ready (the applied — the expressed), and the shared (the published — the multiplied). The examples: the checklists, the templates, the outlines, the snippets. The principle: the packeted knowledge compounds — the distilled once, the reused many.
how_it_works: Distill notes into packets, store reusably, remix into projects, share.

title: PKM Tools Compared
description: The tools — the compared — include: the Notion (the databases — the all-in-one), the Obsidian (the local — the linked; the markdown), the Roam (the bi-directional — the pioneer), the Evernote (the classic — the capture), the Tana (the structured — the supertags), and the Apple Notes (the simple — the synced). The choice: the workflow (the fitting), and the longevity (the plain-text — the portable). The principle: the tool workflow-fitting — the chosen by fit, the portable by format.
key_points: Notion, Obsidian, Roam, Evernote, Tana compared
how_it_works: Map workflow, trial tools, choose fit, keep portable formats.

title: The Weekly PKM Review
description: The review — the knowledge — covers: the inbox (the processed — the zero), the projects (the PARA’d — the current), the highlights (the distilled — the layered), and the expression (the planned — the shipped). The principle: the reviewed knowledge compounds — the processed, the distilled, the expressed.
how_it_works: Weekly: process inbox, review projects, distill, plan expression.

title: Building in Public from Notes
description: The public — the shown work — builds: the notes (the shared — the working), the essays (the distilled — the published), the audience (the gathered — the engaged), and the feedback (the looped — the improved). The principle: the shown work compounds — the shared notes, the published essays, the looped feedback.
how_it_works: Share notes, publish distillations, engage audience, loop feedback.

title: The Anti-Library (Tsundoku with Purpose)
description: The anti-library (the Taleb’s; the Eco’s) — the unread — values: the potential (the unread — the options), the humility (the unknown — the faced), and the capturing (the bought — the queued). The digital: the read-later (the Instapaper — the queued). The principle: the unread valued — the potential kept, the humility faced.
how_it_works: Collect promising material, queue it, sample by resonance, release guilt.

title: Maps of Content (MOCs)
description: The MOCs — the curated — map: the topics (the hubbed — the notes), the curated (the maintained — the guided), and the grown (the organically — the emerged). The vs folders (the flexible — the linked). The principle: the mapped content navigates — the hubbed topics, the curated guides.
how_it_works: Create hub notes, link related, curate paths, maintain lightly.

title: The Commonplace Book Tradition
description: The commonplace (the Locke’s; the historical) — the tradition — keeps: the quotes (the copied — the resonant), the indexed (the headed — the found), and the centuries (the practiced — the proven). The modern: the digital (the revived). The principle: the commonplaced wisdom kept — the copied resonant, the indexed found.
how_it_works: Copy resonant passages, index by head, review, revive digitally.

title: Spaced Repetition Integration
description: The spaced (the Anki) — the remembered — integrates: the cards (the made — the from notes), the reviewed (the daily — the algorithm), and the learned (the retained — the long-term). The principle: the noted remembered — the carded key, the reviewed spaced.
how_it_works: Extract key facts to cards, review daily via algorithm, retain.

title: The 10 Principles of BASB
description: The principles — the Forte’s 10 — state: the borrowed (the creativity — the collected), the capture habit, the project orientation, the completion focus, the slow-burn projects, the sharing imperative, the reliable system, the divergent thinking, and the abundance mindset (the 10th — the summarized). The principle: the principled second brain — the 10 lived.
how_it_works: Study the 10, apply each, review adherence.

title: PKM for Teams
description: The team PKM — the shared brain — builds: the shared (the Notion — the collective), the conventions (the agreed — the naming), the contributions (the everyone — the capturing), and the governed (the maintained — the pruned). The principle: the shared brain thinks — the conventioned, the contributed, the governed.
how_it_works: Set up shared base, agree conventions, invite capture, govern lightly.

title: The Second Brain Troubleshooting Guide
description: The troubleshooting — the diagnosed — fixes: the hoarding (the filtered — the resonance), the organizing (the simplified — the PARA), the expressing (the shipped — the small), the tool (the settled — the one), and the guilt (the released — the archive). The principle: the brain unblocked — the diagnosed, the simplified, the shipped.
key_points: Filter by resonance to cure hoarding
how_it_works: Name the dysfunction, apply fix, simplify, ship something small.

title: The Lifelong Knowledge Compound
description: The compound — the decades — grows: the captured (the lifelong — the habit), the distilled (the deepened — the layered), the expressed (the prolific — the body of work), and the legacy (the left — the wisdom). The principle: the compounded knowledge — the captured lifelong, the expressed prolifically, the legacied wisely.
how_it_works: Capture daily for decades, distill deeply, express prolifically.
